findings.title: Application reported success but state disagrees (submit_expense)
findings.observed: The simulated user completed the workflow and believed it succeeded (“Submitted the client lunch expense as Meals with the note attached.”), but verification of the application's own state failed.
findings.expected: What the interface reports and what the application stores should agree.

findings.title: Saved content is hard to find afterwards
findings.observed: The simulated user entered “Client lunch with Acme” and the application confirmed it with “Expense submitted”. Continuing to use the application, that content was not visible on any screen the user reached afterwards.
findings.userImpact: Users may be unsure whether their input was really saved, or where to go to see it again.
findings.suggestion: Consider showing the saved content on the screen it belongs to, or providing a clearly visible way to reach it.
